maintenance_led.reason: Regulated water, wastewater and recycled water utility billing customers for ongoing service, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from household and commercial utility customers billed under Arizona Corporation Commission-approved rates, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through customer growth in Arizona growth corridors and developer-built systems, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Exclusive water and wastewater utility under a Certificate of Convenience and Necessity; customers cannot switch providers.
